title: Retire completed Local Connector Production closure automation

phases.objective: Remove every live repository automation path for the completed PR #3945 Local Connector Production closure and keep Automation Overlap Guard read-only.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository workflow registrar and governance runner
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A pull request removes the completed one-shot Local Connector closure workflows, executor, and trigger markers from current main-derived automation.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only the read-only Automation Overlap Guard remains, all historical PR #3945 execution and repository-write authority is absent, and the retirement regression passes on the exact candidate head.
steps: Remove the issue-comment, marker-push, and pull-request-target closure workflows.
Remove the embedded closure job, runtime secret, write permissions, and historical concurrency suffix from Automation Overlap Guard.
Remove the closure executor and both one-shot trigger marker files.
Scan live GitHub workflow and script directories for the retired command tokens, executor path, trigger marker, and job identifier.
Execute the focused retirement self-test and publish exact-head E2E evidence.
assertions: The six historical closure workflow, executor, and marker paths do not exist.
Automation Overlap Guard retains contents: read and contains no issue or pull-request write permission.
Automation Overlap Guard contains no BACKEND_API_KEY or completed PR #3945 closure job.
No live GitHub automation file retains a RUN_LOCAL_CONNECTOR_PRODUCTION_CLOSURE token, retired executor reference, trigger marker, or closure job identifier.
No provider call, deployment, Production mutation, credential use, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, external send, protected-ref mutation, or force push is introduced.

phases.objective: Verify workflow registration and lifecycle governance after all retired closure paths are absent from main.
Reject future reintroduction of completed one-shot runtime and repository-write authority into permanent workflows.
Prove Draft and Ready exact-head cycles with CI, E2E, lifecycle, reference integrity, and overlap analysis visible.
Confirm current main contains no live PR #3945 closure automation and no historical trigger can execute.
